what_to_do.en: Tap the word that fits best.

stages.choice_rule: Four one-word shade-family choices from the wordlist or allowed_extra_words. Exactly one matches the picture intensity; the other three are weaker, stronger, or nearby shades. Vary answer_index. Never antonym-only sets except tier 1 when the picture makes the fit obvious.

roots: Give four one-word choices from the wordlist or allowed_extra_words. Never repeat a choice.
Keep all four words in one meaning family such as size, speed, heat, wind, drinking, moving, looking, wetness, or talking.
Exactly one word matches the picture intensity. The others are weaker, stronger, or nearby shades in that family.
Do not use antonym-only sets except in tier 1 when the picture makes the fit obvious.
Never name the target shade in the stem and never describe the picture.
Tier 1 uses distant shades. Tier 2 mixes close and far shades. Tier 3 uses three near-miss shades plus the fit.
Stay in kid world: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands. No real names; use <NAME>.
One tap and one right answer. Vary answer_index across the pool.
Every item needs media with one picturable lemma. Do not invent audio files.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words. Picture plus a far shade such as tiny versus huge or slow versus fast. Wrong choices are much stronger, much weaker, or a different scale word.
tier_rules.2: Grade 2 stems; two-syllable words are fine. Choices are related shades with one clear fit, such as breeze versus wind versus gale. The picture supports the intensity.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss shades in one family, such as glance, peek, look, and stare. The stem does not hint. The child must use the picture to pick the intensity.

small_shade.en: Tiny and little are weaker size words. Big, large, and huge are stronger.
small_shade.ko: tiny와 little은 약한 크기 말이에요. big, large, huge는 더 강한 말이에요.

weak_move.en: Slow is a weaker move word. Fast, quick, and zooming are stronger.
weak_move.ko: slow는 약한 움직임 말이에요. fast, quick, zooming은 더 강해요.

heat_hot.en: Hot is a strong heat word. Warm is milder. Chilly is a cool shade.
heat_hot.ko: hot은 강한 더위 말이에요. warm은 더 약하고 chilly는 서늘한 말이에요.

weak_wind.en: A breeze is a light wind. Gust and gale are much stronger.
weak_wind.ko: breeze는 약한 바람이에요. gust와 gale은 훨씬 강한 바람이에요.

weak_eat.en: Sip is a small drink. Drink is in the middle. Gulp is a big drink.
weak_eat.ko: sip은 조금 마시는 말이에요. drink는 중간이고 gulp은 많이 마셔요.

strong_move.en: Dash is a very fast move. Jog is fast too. Walk and stroll are slower.
strong_move.ko: dash는 아주 빠른 움직임이에요. jog도 빠르고 walk와 stroll은 더 느려요.

strong_look.en: Stare is a long, strong look. Glance and peek are quick, weaker looks.
strong_look.ko: stare는 오래 보는 강한 말이에요. glance와 peek은 잠깐 보는 약한 말이에요.

strong_wet.en: Soaked means very wet. Damp and wet are weaker. Wetter is in the middle.
strong_wet.ko: soaked는 아주 젖은 말이에요. damp와 wet은 더 약하고 wetter는 중간이에요.

strong_shade.en: This word is the strongest in its family. The others are milder shades.
strong_shade.ko: 이 낱말은 같은 뜻 무리에서 가장 강해요. 다른 말들은 더 약해요.

weak_shade.en: This word is the mildest in its family. The others are stronger shades.
weak_shade.ko: 이 낱말은 같은 뜻 무리에서 가장 약해요. 다른 말들은 더 강해요.

loud_talk.en: Yell, shout, and scream are loud talk. Whisper is a very quiet shade.
loud_talk.ko: yell, shout, scream은 큰 소리예요. whisper는 아주 작은 소리예요.

soft_talk.en: Whisper is quiet talk. Yell and shout are much louder shades.
soft_talk.ko: whisper는 작은 소리로 말하는 말이에요. yell과 shout는 훨씬 커요.
